senses.gloss:
(इ) लबि r. 1st cl. (लंबते)
1 To sound.
2 To fall or tumble, to be prostrate.
With अव prefixed,
1 To hold, to support.
2 To hang from or on, to depend from.
3 To rest upon.
4 To hang with the head downwards.
With आङ्,
To trust in, to depend on.
With वि,
To delay, to detain.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
Gained, acquired, obtained, received, got.
f. (-ब्धा)
A woman whose husband or lover is faithless.
E.
लभ to get, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः)
Recovered, restored to one's senses, come to a right mind.
E.
लब्ध, and चेतस् intellect.

mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म)
Born.
E.
लब्ध, and जन्मन् birth.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Wealthy.
E.
लब्ध, and धन wealth.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Sage, learned, a sage, a Paṇḍita.
E.
लब्ध got, and वर्ण praise, celebrity.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
Learned.
E.
लब्ध, and विद्या knowledge.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Revived, recovered from fainting.
E.
लब्ध, and संज्ञा consciousness.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Having found an opportunity or interval.
E.
लब्ध, and अवकाश opportunity.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Obtained.
E.
लभ to gain, क्त्रिमच् aff.

ind.
Having gained or got.
E.
लभ to get, क्त्राच् aff.
